effects.glb_contains: parcels, parts and arms at rest (own nodes: mobile groups; arms skinned to one skeleton each)
effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _assembly): every node of the line's 'move' groups (<group>__*) slides along 'axis' by fmod(t * speed, spacing); per station the arm's groups turn about 'hinge' through 'pivot' by angle_deg * bump(t - t0, window) every 'period' s, 'held' groups hide from t0 to t0 + 0.6 period, 'scan' groups show only during the dip, and the 'reveal' group gets assembly_reveal.gdshader (fragments with dot(world, plane.xyz) < plane.w discarded: parts appear once the parcel passes the arm). Stage 65/66: a station with 'rig' drives the arm's Skeleton3D instead - bone pose rotation about each joint's rest axis (turret yaw, shoulder, elbow, wrist = -(shoulder + elbow), claw twist, 3 fingers) from the rig's motion program (pipeline/arm_motion.py: jerk-limited servo moves, conveyor tracking, inverse kinematics every frame; no sway)
